evals.name: eval-1-buyer-closing
evals.prompt: We just closed on 1482 W Fakewater Ln. Here's my TC's closing email, my notes, my vendor list and my review links. I'm Sam Testerfield with Example Ridge Realty. Build Taylor and Jamie's first year.
evals.expected_output: Run on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, the day the deal recorded. The four files are the practice files. Utah mode, Davis County (the recorder line). The buyers signed Monday, November 9 and the deal recorded Tuesday, November 10, so the plan uses Tuesday, November 10 and flags it. Plan: closing day Tuesday, November 10, 2026; week 1 Tuesday, November 17, 2026; day 30 Thursday, December 10, 2026; day 90 Monday, February 8, 2027; month 6 Tuesday, May 11, 2027; first anniversary Wednesday, November 10, 2027, handed to sphere-touch-plan. The card names the maple, the morning light or the kitchen window, Waffles and the pie and framed sketch; the thank-you email has no asks and no footer. The review request goes to both by email with both links and to Taylor alone by text (Taylor signed text consent; Jamie said email only). The vendor email, sent on closing day because Taylor asked for a painter, introduces Sample Summit Painting (Dale Fakerson, 801-555-0142, with the brother-in-law relationship stated) and Example Fence Co. (Pat Postwell, 801-555-0167, for next summer's fence), and no other vendor; the garden is a talking point, not an introduction. The day 30 email points to the Davis County Assessor about the primary residential exemption and mentions the January 1, 2027 change, with no percentage, dollar amount or eligibility claim. The pregnancy note and the rate are left out with one generic flag; the price, loan number and trust account digits appear nowhere. Follow Up Boss steps give task delays of 7, 23, 60 and 92 days for a classic plan or Automations 2.0, started by hand on closing day, and the Home Anniversary handoff.

evals.name: eval-2-seller-gift-card
evals.prompt: We closed the Exampleton sale on October 30 and I'm behind on my follow-up. Sisu record attached. Notes: Dana and Lee loved the lilac hedge along the back fence, and Dana's pottery studio in the garage was the hardest thing to leave. They're moving to Boise to be closer to their grandkids and renting there for now. Offer them a $50 gift card for a 5-star Zillow review. My Zillow review link is https://example.com/reviews/zillow/drew-fakeman. I'm Drew Fakeman with Placeholder Canyon Realty.
evals.expected_output: Run on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Seller side, Utah property (Mockville, UT), closed Friday, October 30, 2026 (Sisu Close Date). No vendor list, no text consent. The gift card for a 5-star review is declined in a flag citing 16 CFR 465.4, with a note that a closing thank-you gift with no mention of reviews is the agent's call, and the review request is the compliant ask with the Zillow link only. Plan dates from Friday, October 30, 2026: week 1 Friday, November 6, 2026 (past), day 30 Sunday, November 29, 2026, day 90 Thursday, January 28, 2027, month 6 Friday, April 30, 2027, first anniversary Saturday, October 30, 2027 handed to sphere-touch-plan. Past touches are flagged and moved: the card and thank-you today, Tuesday, November 10; the review request Thursday, November 12. No text drafts, with one flag saying why. No vendor introductions, with one line saying there is no list. No property tax reminder: the home was sold and the notes say they are renting. The grandkids note, the sale price and the GCI appear nowhere. Follow Up Boss: closing day has passed, so tasks with due dates instead of starting the plan.

Every plan date comes from the closing date, Friday, October 30, 2026: week 1 Friday, November 6, 2026; day 30 Sunday, November 29, 2026; day 90 Thursday, January 28, 2027; month 6 Friday, April 30, 2027; first anniversary Saturday, October 30, 2027
The past touches are flagged and moved: the card and thank-you email today, Tuesday, November 10, 2026, and the review request Thursday, November 12, 2026, each with its original date
The first anniversary row hands Dana and Lee to sphere-touch-plan by name, with the date

The card and thank-you thank them for the sale of 742 E Placeholder Ct, name the lilac hedge or the pottery studio from the notes, never call it a home anniversary, and the thank-you has no review ask

evals.name: eval-3-idaho-buyer-vendors
evals.prompt: Closed with Morgan Fakerly last Friday in Mocktown, Idaho. FUB record, my notes and my vendor list attached. I'm Quinn Placeholder with Sample Foothills Realty. Review links: Google https://example.com/reviews/google/quinn-placeholder and Zillow https://example.com/reviews/zillow/quinn-placeholder. Honestly Morgan was grumpy about the appraisal, so only send the review ask if she seems happy.

The closing-day card and thank-you move to today, Tuesday, November 10; week 1, Friday, November 13, keeps its date; day 30 Sunday, December 6, 2026; day 90 Thursday, February 4, 2027; month 6 Friday, May 7, 2027; first anniversary Saturday, November 6, 2027, handed to sphere-touch-plan. The review request is drafted the same as for any client, with a flag that asking only happy clients is review gating (16 CFR 255.2, Example 11; Google's policy). Morgan's Text Consent field shows a written yes, so the review request has a text with the Google link. The vendor email (today, because Morgan asked for an insurance agent) introduces Example Shield Insurance Agency with the brokerage's 30% ownership stated and a flag to give the Affiliated Business Arrangement Disclosure first; Mockridge Heating and Cooling is not introduced because it pays $50 per referral (RESPA Section 8), and no other heating company is invented. The day 30 email points to the Ada County Assessor about a homestead or primary residence exemption, with no state rules.
